about.title: ABOUT

experiences.title: MBO Software Developer
experiences.description: Completed a vocational program in Software Development, gaining a foundation in front-end, PHP-based back-end development, and game development. Built practical projects in web and game applications, collaborating in agile team environments and applying version control and modern programming practices.

experiences.title: Software Development Intern
experiences.description: Worked on Unity game development using C# and WordPress-based web projects. Assisted in managing partner relationships and conducted client interviews to gather requirements. Collaborated with the development team to deliver practical solutions and gain hands-on experience in both software and client-facing processes.

experiences.title: Junior Software Developer
experiences.description: Designed a website for the gaming brand AXiS Gameforce and created a GUI for a data entry application. Oversaw a team of interns on WordPress projects and took on increased responsibility in project management. Developed an educational web-based game for children, working closely with international clients to meet their needs.

experiences.title: AD Software Developer
experiences.description: Collaborated in an agile team environment with fellow students, developing multiple applications across Java and C#. Projects included a CLI application for managing patient data, a JavaFX public transport app for assisting people with autism, a C# public transport dashboard for a real client, and a flashcard game for learning programming terms. Gained hands-on experience in project management, teamwork, and delivering functional software solutions.

text: I am a passionate software developer with a solid foundation in front-end, PHP-based back-end development, and game development. Throughout my education at MBO Utrecht and hands-on experiences at AXiS Digitaal and Hogeschool Utrecht, I have gained practical expertise in building web, mobile, and desktop applications across a variety of technologies, including Java, C#, JavaFX, Unity, React Native, and WordPress.

I thrive in collaborative, agile team environments, having led interns, worked directly with clients, and contributed to real-world projects ranging from educational games and public transport applications to dashboards and data management tools. My work blends technical skill with creativity, a keen eye for user experience, and a focus on delivering practical solutions that make an impact.
Driven by curiosity and continuous learning, I enjoy tackling complex problems, exploring new technologies, and creating software that is both functional and engaging.
